## Purpose and scope

What changes, why, and which existing issue/PR or source revision is authoritative?

## Sources, editorial boundaries and rights

- Original source editions / source SHA or commit:
- Files and ledger decisions changed (or intentionally unchanged):
- Uncertainties, abstentions and any editorial approval needed:
- Redistribution/publication decision: **no publication unless separately approved**.

## Validation evidence

- [ ] New maintained Python tool has a meaningful regression test (including a negative case).
- [ ] No temporary files or one-shot research scripts unnecessarily retained.
- [ ] Current README/method docs updated where needed; history remains in issues/PRs.
- [ ] Workflow paths, local Markdown links and hygiene checks pass.
- [ ] Offline tests and relevant pinned-source workflows pass.
- [ ] Original text/word IDs/versification/annotations, review ledgers and rights locks preserved or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] Where a producer changed: intermediate files and historical released ZIP bytes compared, or reason this is not applicable recorded.
- [ ] Implemented / tested / editorially approved / published statuses stated separately.

## Results and follow-up

Tests and workflow links, exact hashes where applicable, remaining limitations,
and anything that must not be auto-merged or published.
